verses.1: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.2: Dominion and fear are with him; He maketh peace in his high places.
verses.3: Is there any number of his armies? And upon whom doth not his light arise?
verses.4: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
verses.5: Behold, even the moon hath no brightness, And the stars are not pure in his sight:
verses.6: How much less man, that is a worm! And the son of man, that is a worm!
